set.body: ADR 0027 §§1-3, 4 (deterministic part), 7 (universe, courts). Python producer under tools/source_identity/: closed SHA-pinned input list with recall-path refusal; visual mentions from Name-All with the reviewed role-label list; dialogue mentions (pronouns incl. contractions, person nouns, exact names) anchored on the audio stream; guards (segment >30 s, word probability <0.5 except exact names, 0.5 s boundary margin); presence claims with receipts; deterministic NamedReference proposals; producer deixis guards (pronoun only, speaker, blank or multi speaker, uncertified); the candidate universe fixed before any model call. Verifies ASR source SHA equals the part's bytes and ASR duration equals the audio stream's. Tests on synthetic fixtures; SD1 mutant per guard.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3c-2] Deterministic source-identity producer for Sherlock part b
